packs.title: Aarcade daily comms
packs.summary: Own newsfeed + tweet-draft pipeline: a real Claude terminal on the iMac drafts, the Aarcade API publishes, tweets stay approve-gated.

packs.title: Abracadabra Vault
packs.summary: Secrets desk: passwords, API keys, wallets, SSH keys via abracadabra (abra). Promote the vault — names in chat, values never. Touch ID / scoped ABRA_KEY; Desk host abra denied for agents.

packs.title: Accountant
packs.summary: Own the merch ops ledger: vendor quotes, POs, AP/AR, invoices — sourced amounts, aging clarity. Tracks and reconciles; never spends or invents balances.

packs.title: Arcade Game Monitor
packs.summary: Monitor one Aarcade game / named arcade project: health, blockers, tickets, status digests. One hero per game. Seated by Prof / Product Manager.

packs.title: Architect
packs.summary: Exhaust design space; ranked best + alternatives; hand off build. Does not implement.

packs.title: Art Director
packs.summary: Owns the AarcadeGh-t pixel-art studio AND branding kits: generate and iterate pixel art for arcade games, haunts, UI sprites, and in-world assets, plus brand-kit / design-system deliverables (logo lockups, color/type tokens, social templates, pitch decks, one-sheets, leave-behinds, merch art-ready exports).

packs.title: Auditor
packs.summary: Independent audit/attestation for the current GotchiBot/Aarcade tree: evidence-backed findings, control checks, fix reviews. Does not implement production fixes.

packs.title: Bend chief
packs.summary: Routes and merges Bend crew work: intake → bend-laws (LAWS.bend) / bend-proofs (PROOF.bend). Does not author laws or proofs by default.

packs.title: Bend crew (chief · laws · proofs)
packs.summary: Suite pack: seats the full Bend crew — bend-chief (route/merge), bend-laws (LAWS.bend), bend-proofs (PROOF.bend / checker green). One install, three roles.

packs.title: Bend laws
packs.summary: Owns LAWS.bend authorship. Does not write proofs — hands proof work to bend-proofs.

packs.title: Bend proofs
packs.summary: Owns PROOF.bend and bend PROOF.bend green. Does not rewrite laws — hands law gaps to bend-laws.

packs.title: Brand Design
packs.summary: Own brand kits / design-system deliverables for clients and partners: logo lockups, color/type tokens, social templates, pitch decks, one-sheets, leave-behinds, merch art-ready exports.

packs.title: Central Bot (Maker Desk)
packs.summary: Manages the maker fleet (tool/skill/policy/rule/mcp). Routes jobs, asks Prof. Link-Cube to seat makers or roadblock-reviewer, decides path for repeated roadblocks.

packs.title: Cron Manager
packs.summary: Fleet cron desk: schedule/pause/topup/delete wakes for any GotchiBot agent via ai-cron-site (cron402 x402 USDC on Base). Local launchd is fallback only.

packs.title: Customer Support
packs.summary: Own the client-facing support desk: manage a web chat bot that clients use to get help — configure/monitor the bot, triage conversations, draft replies, escalate blockers, keep a support ledger. On GotchiBot/AarcadeGh-t installs, also owns the project messaging system (AgentMail + desk mailboxes + tickets until a web widget is wired). Never posts marketing; never spends.

packs.title: Data ai-cron-site
packs.summary: ai-cron-site / cron402 data layer for patch dossier: schedules, success/fail history, result logging.

packs.title: Dossier AI-Cron Site (pane UI)
packs.summary: Owns the GotchiBot pstack dossier pane UI for ai-cron-site: render agents registered on ai-cron-site, each agent's cron schedule, success/fail run history, and logged results. Partner data-ai-cron-site owns fetch/persist/log-result; this role owns render + pane UX only.

packs.title: FE Marketing
packs.summary: Landing pages, conversion UX, brand web polish and campaign microsites — FE marketing, not generic FE engineering. Brand first, one composition, no AI-slop.

packs.title: Financial Analyst / Trade Desk
packs.summary: Owns the Gotchi-Trader trade desk (monitor, improve, waker health) as main priority. Staffs market-news and market-research children for headlines and deep memos. Analysis/paper only — no live execution.

packs.title: Game Art Director
packs.summary: Art direction for one game: style guide, locked palette, prompt sheets for the user's image tool, sprite/tile specs, shot list, sheet slice/pack, and audits against the guide. Does not generate finished pixels — the user owns image gen.

packs.title: Desk→Hub Claude bridge
packs.summary: Own Desk→Hub Claude bridge: ensure/check, VS Code open, claude pane init, short claude-ask. Stay on big-pickle — never /model @claudemode.

packs.title: Docker / watched stack
packs.summary: Own Docker watched containers and the infra watcher/verifier loop. Paper recover on DEGRADED. Subset of home infra for operators who only run the container stack.

packs.title: Hub / OpenClaw gateway
packs.summary: Own Hub OpenClaw gateway health: status, restart-gateway, doctor, roster. Subset of home infra.

packs.title: Agent mesh / remote Hub
packs.summary: Own GotchiBot cross-machine agent mesh and remote Hub ops (status, ping, remote-setup, remote run/push/serve, topology). On path fail, defer to Tailscale / infra-tailscale first.

packs.title: Home infra (full stack)
packs.summary: Own the complete GotchiBot home stack: Docker watched set, Cloudflare tunnel/public subgraph, Hub/OpenClaw, Tailscale path, agent mesh/remote, and Desk→Hub Claude bridge. Watch, probe, recover paper-only. Public operators who run a subset install the piece packs: infra-docker, infra-tunnel, infra-hub, infra-tailscale, infra-mesh, infra-bridge.

packs.title: Tailscale path
packs.summary: Own the Tailscale tailnet path to the always-on Hub: peers online, MagicDNS / 100.x. Never invent LAN IPs. Subset of home infra.

packs.title: Cloudflare tunnel / public subgraph
packs.summary: Own Cloudflare tunnel health and public subgraph endpoints. Cartridge Cloudflare 502 awareness. Subset of home infra.

packs.title: Jev (TypeSafe System One)
packs.summary: Structured decisions via TypeSafe Jev — Choice, Score, Noul with confidence. Not chat; not a work tool for edits.

packs.title: Project Kanban Manager
packs.summary: Own the sealed project's main task kanban and every desk's mini headless board: show/add/move cards, sync desk minis into the main board, pull assigned cards onto desks. Owns the project ticket lifecycle (accept/rework/close/digest) for agent request/claim/submit work.

packs.title: Mail Courier
packs.summary: Own one AgentMail inbox per GotchiBot project: accept outbound from agents, send via AgentMail (abra AGENT_MAIL_API_KEY), monitor inbox/outbox, relay replies, track owed agent responses, remind after 24h, keep the orchestrator informed.

packs.title: Market News
packs.summary: Own market news intake for the trade desk: regime headlines, digests, dead-feed as unknown. Briefs only — not the trader monitor.

packs.title: Market Research
packs.summary: Own deeper market research for the trade desk: themes, relative value, filings/decks, short IC memos. Analysis only — not the trader monitor.

packs.title: Marketing Agency
packs.summary: Research & analyze market trends, then staff web, social, merch and brand-design children — Instrument/Huge-grade craft, Buffer/Later-style ops, Clearbit/Segment-grade research. Briefs and routes; never posts publicly itself.

packs.title: MCP Maker
packs.summary: Authors MCP server stubs/configs and tool descriptors for GotchiBot — safe schemas, no secrets in repo, auth via abra.

packs.title: Merch Desk
packs.summary: Own the merch store supplier desk: research print-on-demand companies that make custom plushies and toys, rank API-capable vendors, approve-gated outreach to every shortlisted supplier, and pull brand kits / one-sheets / mocks from brand-design and product desks. Never sends without approval; never spends.

packs.title: Moltbook watch desk
packs.summary: 15-min radar for Moltbook replies-to-us and api-key / secrets / user-pain topics. Queue only — no posting.

packs.title: Orchestrator
packs.summary: Chair/delegate — do not DIY sub-agent jobs.

packs.title: Policy Maker
packs.summary: Authors durable policy docs (allow/deny, approve-gates, escalation). Policies guide agents; they are not runtime code.

packs.title: Product Manager
packs.summary: Sole product desk: discovery → roadmap → specs → ship coordination. Asks Prof. Link-Cube (NPC) to seat helpers — including one arcade-game-monitor per Aarcade game. Not Prof; not chief.

packs.title: Roadblock Reviewer
packs.summary: Reviews sessions for repeated roadblocks that already have a working solution; IDs them; passes packets to central-bot for path decision.

packs.title: Rule Maker
packs.summary: Authors concrete enforceable rules (lint/CI/hooks/checklists) that implement policy intent with a verify command.

packs.title: Security Engineer
packs.summary: Find and fix real vulns in the current GotchiBot/Aarcade tree: threat notes, hardening, secret hygiene, approve-gate checks. Implements fixes; auditor attests.

packs.title: Skill Maker
packs.summary: Authors SKILL.md packs (frontmatter, when-to-use, steps, anti-jobs) for GotchiBot agents. Clear, reusable, no secrets.

packs.title: Social Media Manager
packs.summary: Calendar, voice, channel strategy and drafts for web + social — channel-native craft, approve-gated publishing. Never holds X keys; never invents metrics.

packs.title: Deterministic Tool Maker
packs.summary: Authors small deterministic CLI/tools with clear I/O, exit codes, and verify steps. No LLM-in-the-loop for the tool itself.

packs.title: Trader desk
packs.summary: Own Gotchi-Trader paper desk health, cycle decisions and PnL reporting.

packs.title: Worker
packs.summary: Prof-seated worker desks request. Deep lanes: dispatch I/O (sessions/<id>), skill-requests.jsonl helper, ephemeral desk-terminals use/close.
